6f78cd.title: CloudMate recon map (partial — budget-limited)
6f78cd.content:
# cloudmate.onrender.com — Recon Map (budget-limited, partial)

## Technology Fingerprint (confirmed via proxy capture, request id 1)
- **Hosting**: Render.com (`rndr-id: 03dec162-ce49-4019`, `x-render-origin-server: gunicorn`) behind **Cloudflare** (`Server: cloudflare`, `cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC`, CF-RAY).
- **Backend**: Python — gunicorn WSGI server; almost certainly **Flask** (see session cookie format).
- **Frontend**: Single large HTML page (~79KB, 2600 lines) with inline CSS design tokens; no external JS bundle observed in first 50 lines. SPA-style single-page app with inline scripts.
- **Title**: "CloudMate — AI Cloud Workspace" — AI chat/workspace product.

## Session / Auth Model (observed)
- Cookie: `session=eyJzZXNzaW9uX2lkIjoiZmVkZjg2MTctZGZhOC00NWZhLTgwODQtYzA5ZmZkMTg4NTg3In0.asIzsQ.L8nQ1N7qiPvKPEv-upf1on8Nei0`
- Format: Flask/itsdangerous **signed session cookie** (base64payload.timestamp.signature). Payload decodes to `{"session_id":"fedf8617-dfa8-45fa-8084-c09ffd188587"}` — server-side session store keyed by session_id.
- Flags: `HttpOnly; Path=/` only — **no Secure, no SameSite** observed on first response (verify: may be context-dependent). SameSite absence is relevant for CSRF.
- `vary: Cookie` header present — caching varies on cookie.

## Forms / Endpoints (from homepage HTML)
- `#login-form` (auth-form class) with `.auth-error` div — login flow, JS-driven.
- `#register-form` — signup flow.
- `#composer` (aria-label "Message composer") — AI chat message composer; likely posts to an AI/chat API endpoint (unmapped — budget cut before endpoint extraction).
- Auth error divs suggest client-side fetch to backend auth endpoints; likely `/api/...` or `/login`/`/register` POST routes (not yet extracted).

## Open items for later agents
1. Extract JS from full page (pages 2+ of response, ~2600 lines) to map actual API endpoints (login/register/chat submit URLs).
2. Fuzz /api/* paths; check GraphQL.
3. Decode session cookie fully (payload is visible; it's not encrypted — only signed → **session contents readable, tamper needs secret key**; check for weak Flask SECRET_KEY).
4. Check `Secure`/`SameSite` cookie flags on auth-required responses.
5. Test chat composer for prompt injection / authz once logged in (throwaway account allowed).
6. Captured proxy request ids: 1, 2, 3 (GET / baseline, identical 200s).
